message.content: Viscous friction force depends on relative velocity, fluid viscosity, contact area, and the coefficient. coefficient values determine when the physical pendulum model should include a torque proportional to angular velocity. velocity damping should be included when air or fluid resistance causes noticeable amplitude loss during the swing.
